NoteId.description: Stable note identifier, e.g. "n_a1b2c3". Generated at creation, never rewritten on move/re-route. This is the write handle.

ProjectSlug.description: Hierarchical project path/slug relative to the KB root, e.g. "Growth/Q3". Segments are folder names; no leading/trailing or empty segments. Each segment must also be a legal Windows folder name (no reserved device names such as CON/PRN/NUL, no trailing dot or space, none of the characters Windows forbids in a path segment), and may not start with "." or "_" — those prefixes mark infra folders (".obsidian", "_assets") that routing discovery skips, so such a project would be writable yet invisible to routing. The Phase 2 writer rejects violations. "Inbox" (any casing) is a reserved folder name — a real project may not use it — and "sessions", "raw", and "chats" (any casing) are reserved as first segments: <KB root>/sessions/ holds raw session artifacts and <KB root>/chats/ holds raw chat transcripts, never notes ("raw" stays reserved alongside them; a nested segment like "Data/raw" is fine). This is the canonical project handle accepted by tools. Because no real project can be named "Inbox", read tools that filter by project reuse it as a sentinel meaning "unfiled" — see search_notes's project field.

IsoDate.description: Calendar date, ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 full-date, e.g. "2026-07-11".

IsoDateTime.description: Timestamp, RFC 3339 date-time with offset ("Z" or numeric), e.g. "2026-07-11T14:03:00Z" or "2026-07-09T14:00:00-07:00".

MeetingCategory.description: The meeting's genre: the second facet beside `type`, classified at distill time and correctable by hand.

has_more.description: True if more results exist beyond this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque token to pass as the next request's cursor; null when has_more is false.

total_estimate.description: Total matches when the underlying candidate pool was exhausted (an exact count), or null when it was not — a truncated pool knows only its own size, which would understate the total. Never a value the caller can treat as a floor for how much is left; use has_more for that.

PageInfo.description: Cursor-based pagination envelope. Cursors are opaque and mutation-safe (they encode sort key + id, not an offset).

path.description: Current note path relative to the KB root, e.g. "Growth/Q3/weekly-sync.md"; an unfiled (Inbox) note's path begins with "Inbox/". The filename is a slug of the title (or the id when the title slugifies to empty).

title.description: Note display title. The frontmatter `title` when the note carries one (kept in full, past the 40-char filename slug); otherwise the de-slugged filename stem for a legacy or hand-made note without the key.

project.description: Owning project slug, or null if unfiled (Inbox). Frontmatter stores the sentinel string "Inbox" for the null case.

date.description: Frontmatter date, verbatim as stored: full timestamp with the device's local offset (not UTC) when a time is known, local calendar date otherwise. The writer accepts only these two shapes and rejects a naive timestamp with no offset.

tags.description: Frontmatter tags; empty array when the frontmatter key is absent (the writer omits the key for untagged notes, and normalizes a hand-edited empty list to an omitted key). Each tag is lowercase kebab-case.

source.description: Frontmatter source: a capture keyword (transcript | quick-capture | chat | import | manual) or a repo-relative path to the raw artifact. Disambiguation: a value exactly equal to a keyword is that keyword; anything else is the path.

confidence.description: Routing confidence 0..1, or null when no routing score exists (hand-filed or imported notes).

category.description: The meeting's genre, or null when the note carries none (an unclassified meeting, or any non-meeting note, where the key is invalid).

category_confidence.description: How strongly the distill pass backed `category`, or null. Cleared when a person sets the category by hand, so its presence answers whether anyone confirmed the genre.

tracking.description: The per-meeting commitment-tracking override, or null when the note inherits (the category default, then the global default of full tracking). Gates which extracted items earn a ledger entry; extraction itself is unconditional.

NoteSummary.description: Core note metadata shared by search hits, recent-notes lists, and routing results. Deliberately open (no unevaluatedProperties) because SearchHit and MeetingMeta extend it — see Conventions.

score.description: Fused RRF relevance score; higher is better.

rank.description: 1-based rank within the full result set.

snippet.description: Highlighted excerpt of the matching passage.

SearchHit.description: A NoteSummary augmented with retrieval score, rank, and snippet. Uses unevaluatedProperties (not additionalProperties) so the composed NoteSummary fields are allowed.
